text: This report responds to a request from Toronto and East York Community requesting City Planning staff to report to its April 4, 2018 meeting with the confirmed funding sources to proceed with the re-location of the hydro poles in front of 1009 Coxwell Avenue.

The Toronto and East York Community Council referred the Item back to staff with a request that the Acting Director, Community Planning, Toronto and East York District, in consultation with Toronto Hydro and the General Manager, Transportation Services report to the May 2, 2018 meeting of the Toronto and East York Community Council with an alternate strategy for re-location of the hydro pole(s) in a staged plan, with estimated costs and possible funding sources, to ensure that the sidewalk outside 1009 Coxwell Avenue meets the Vibrant Streets guidelines and to ensure the sidewalk is accessible.
